posts.name: Opengeni

posts.name: devpit

posts.description: devpit is a native desktop app for running Claude Code agents. One terminal you actually watch, a board where moving a card runs real work, a cost on every agent call, and an orchestrator that sees every project at once. Local-first, open source.

posts.name: Jarq
posts.tagline: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor

Pro: $4.99/mo or $39/yr. 14-day Pro trial, no card.

posts.name: Siteprint

Built for interactive interfaces, animated states, loaders, controls, visual effects, and UI that can transform from one form into another.
